name: Kairai no Hazukashime o Kimi ni
source:
Hero is given the power to manipulate girls after meeting girl Sarah. It's not a complete control power, so needs to be mastered on daily basis.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在遇見女孩莎拉後被賦予了操縱女孩的能力。他還不能完全控制這股力量，必須每天練習。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
